SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor

Class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationKinetics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationKinetics
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationKinetics extends Object implements Serializable
Primary-source screening correlation for abiotic oxidation of total dissolved sulfide by air-saturated oxygen.

Millero et al. measured total-sulfide loss in air-saturated water, seawater, and NaCl solutions. For pH 4-8, 278.15-338.15 K, and ionic strength 0-6 mol/kg water, their simplified correlation is log10(k) = 10.50 + 0.16 pH - 3000/T + 0.44 sqrt(I). The second-order rate constant uses the reported kg-water mol-1 h-1 basis.

This class does not calculate oxygen solubility, sulfide speciation, products, pressure effects, or a pipeline source term. Exposure methods require the caller to supply the molality of air-saturated dissolved oxygen and assume that it remains constant.

1.0
Author:
NeqSim Team

    • secondOrderRateConstantRange

      public static AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationKinetics.RateConstantRange secondOrderRateConstantRange(double temperatureK, double pH, double ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater)
      Calculate the nominal correlation and its reported one-standard-deviation fit interval.

      The source reports a standard deviation of 0.18 in log10(k). The returned interval therefore multiplies and divides the nominal rate by 10^0.18. It represents regression scatter, not a complete predictive or mechanistic uncertainty.

      Parameters:
      temperatureK - aqueous temperature [K]
      pH - aqueous pH on the source-compatible scale
      ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater - ionic strength [mol/kg water]
      Returns:
      immutable nominal and one-standard-deviation rate interval
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when an input is non-finite or outside the published range

    • screenAirSaturatedExposure

      public static AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationKinetics.ScreeningResult screenAirSaturatedExposure(double airSaturatedOxygenMolality, double elapsedTimeHours, double temperatureK, double pH, double ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater)
      Screen total-sulfide loss for an exposure with constant air-saturated dissolved oxygen.

      The remaining fraction is the exact pseudo-first-order result exp(-k[O2]t). No reaction products or oxygen consumption are calculated.

      Parameters:
      airSaturatedOxygenMolality - dissolved oxygen molality for an independently established air-saturated aqueous state [mol/kg water]
      elapsedTimeHours - elapsed exposure time [h]
      temperatureK - aqueous temperature [K]
      pH - aqueous pH on the source-compatible scale
      ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater - ionic strength [mol/kg water]
      Returns:
      immutable exposure-screening result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when elapsed time is negative or non-finite, oxygen is not finite and positive, or the state is outside the published range

    • screenResidenceTimeRange

      public static AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationKinetics.ResidenceTimeRangeResult screenResidenceTimeRange(double airSaturatedOxygenMolality, double residenceTimeHours, double temperatureK, double pH, double ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater)
      Screen a residence time against the published correlation and its reported fit scatter.

      The dimensionless Damkohler exposure is Da = k[O2]t = t/tau, where tau = 1/(k[O2]). Lower, nominal, and upper results use the source's one-standard-deviation log10(k) interval. No categorical regime threshold is imposed.

      Parameters:
      airSaturatedOxygenMolality - dissolved oxygen molality for an independently established air-saturated aqueous state [mol/kg water]
      residenceTimeHours - caller-provided aqueous residence time [h]
      temperatureK - aqueous temperature [K]
      pH - aqueous pH on the source-compatible scale
      ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater - ionic strength [mol/kg water]
      Returns:
      immutable uncertainty-aware residence-time result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when residence time is negative or non-finite, oxygen is not finite and positive, the state is outside the published range, or an intermediate result is not finite

    • timeToRemainingFractionRange

      public static AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationKinetics.TargetTimeRangeResult timeToRemainingFractionRange(double airSaturatedOxygenMolality, double targetRemainingFraction, double temperatureK, double pH, double ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater)
      Calculate the time required to reach a target remaining-total-sulfide fraction.

      The required dimensionless exposure is -ln(fRemaining). The shortest, nominal, and longest times use the upper, nominal, and lower pseudo-first-order rates from the source's one-standard-deviation log10(k) interval. A target of one requires exactly zero time; zero is rejected because finite first-order time cannot reach an exactly zero remaining fraction.

      Parameters:
      airSaturatedOxygenMolality - dissolved oxygen molality for an independently established air-saturated aqueous state [mol/kg water]
      targetRemainingFraction - target total-sulfide fraction in the interval (0, 1]
      temperatureK - aqueous temperature [K]
      pH - aqueous pH on the source-compatible scale
      ionicStrengthMolPerKgWater - ionic strength [mol/kg water]
      Returns:
      immutable target-time range
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the target is not finite and in (0, 1], oxygen is not finite and positive, the state is outside the published range, or a calculated time is not finite
